race.comment: DAZZLING DIAMOND (11) was plain at Ipswich last start, though her prior third here and sound local record keep her firmly in the mix. PACIERA (10) was good through the line first-up here and is proven at 1300m, so she has scope to advance second-up. RICKYTHESTEAMBOAT (3) drops back from Saturday grade, where he made late ground at big odds. Maloney taking over is a good push but he draws to get back a long way again. If the pace is hot he can launch late. CLUBHOUSE (6) is back from five weeks off after an eye-catching Ipswich finish, finishing ninth but only beaten three and a half lengths on soft ground. In the mix on best.
